newsitem.title: USA: ConAgra sees no impact from gain on sale.
newsitem.headline: ConAgra sees no impact from gain on sale.

text.p: ConAgra Inc said Tuesday that a fiscal 1998 first quarter gain on the sale of its Country General specialty retailing business is not expected to have a significant impact on earnings.

The gain on the sale will have no significant effect on earnings due to offsetting reserves to be provided for other dispositions and above-budget spending on special marketing initiatives, ConAgra said in a news release.
The transaction is expected to close on July 3.

Late last month, ConAgra agreed to sell Country General stores to Central Tractor Farm & Country for undisclosed terms. Country General, based in Grand Island, Neb., operates 114 farm stores and has annual sales of about $300 million.
